checkpoint: The S.S. Anne (VermilionCity, SSAnne_* scripts.inc). The step onto (23, 33) (VermilionCity_EventScript_CheckTicket) has the sailor (24, 33) ask for a ticket; the S.S. TICKET (00.18) is shown and the player turns east to him. Then onto the pier (23, 34), along the gangway, through 1F, by legs off its cabins' doormats on row 10, which planned routes cross, and up its stairs (3, 8) to 2F. The step onto (30, 6), below the Captain's door (30, 2) (SSAnne_2F_Corridor_EventScript_RivalTriggerLeft), brings the rival out and down to (30, 5); the player keeps facing north, and after the battle he walks round the player and off. For a player who took Squirtle: Pidgeotto Lv19, Raticate Lv16, Kadabra Lv18, Ivysaur Lv20. The ship's trainers are in its cabins and on its deck, off the way. The Captain (5, 4) faces up; talked to from (5, 5) he is rubbed on the back and gives HM01 (VAR_MAP_SCENE_VERMILION_CITY 1). Back out through 1F's door (19, 1): on the gangway the ship sails (SSAnne_Exterior_ExitSSAnne), the player is put on (23, 34) and walked up to (23, 32) (VermilionCity_EventScript_ExitSSAnne). Cut is taught later, to the Oddish.
